title: Design decisions
summary: Ninety-two closed JAOS design decisions, D1 through D92, each stated as the decision itself with the measurement that closed it.
scope: D1-D92 (92 closed decisions, one section per ID)
language and toolchain: C23, GCC 14 minimum, Linux, WSL2 development
no external dependencies; test-only dependencies exempt
implemented from literature, not from other solvers' code
third-party licences and exception authority
determinism by default; bit-identical results
work units as public contract; no claim without a run
tolerances and bound-proximity tests
independent checker: guarantees, limits, dual bound certificates
unboundedness rays and optimality declaration
primal simplex, dual simplex, ratio test, re-entry clean-up
Bland's rule and anti-cycling
pricing: row traversal, pattern reads, partial pricing, multiple pricing
LU factorization, fill, pivot search, elimination
BTRAN and FTRAN sparsity
warm re-solve and basis reuse across model changes
public API shape, options API, logging and callbacks
budgets and resumption
presolve
benchmark gate, campaigns, parallel instance execution
solver comparison against rivals including Clp
shipping compiler flags and PGO
threading layer over pthreads
build: one plain Makefile
scope of the solver: generic mathematical programming, CPU only, constraint programming excluded
notes: Type and precedence come from the manifest (ADR, 0). The document carries no YAML frontmatter and no per-entry 'Status: Accepted' field; its header states 'Closed decisions only, with the measurement that closed them', which is the Accepted equivalent here — locked set true for all 92 entries. Open items live in PLAN.md, not here.
